user.title: Shelly Extras
user.description: Add the Shelly Extras actions to Home Assistant. No configuration is required.

abort.already_configured: Shelly Extras is already set up.

no_properties.message: Specify at least one property to change (brightness, color temperature or color).

no_shelly_lights.message: No Shelly lights were found in the selected target. This action only works on lights from the core Shelly integration.

no_rpc_devices.message: No Gen2+ (RPC) Shelly devices were found in the selected target. Raw RPC calls are only supported on Gen2 and newer Shelly devices.

change_light.name: Change light
change_light.description: Changes brightness, color or color temperature of Shelly lights without changing their on/off state. If a light is off it stays off; the new values apply the next time it turns on. Fields match light.turn_on, so this is a drop-in replacement.

transition.name: Transition
transition.description: Duration, in seconds, over which to fade to the new values.

rgb_color.name: Color
rgb_color.description: Color in RGB format. A list of three integers, each 0-255.

color_temp.name: Color temperature (mireds)
color_temp.description: White color temperature in mireds. Converted to Kelvin.

rgbw_color.name: RGBW-color
rgbw_color.description: Color in RGBW format. A list of four integers, each 0-255.

rgbww_color.name: RGBWW-color
rgbww_color.description: Color in RGBWW format. A list of five integers, each 0-255. The two white values are combined into the single Shelly white channel.

hs_color.name: Color (hue, saturation)
hs_color.description: Color in hue/saturation format. Hue 0-360, saturation 0-100.

xy_color.name: XY-color
xy_color.description: Color in XY format. A list of two floats between 0 and 1.

color_name.name: Color name
color_name.description: A human-readable CSS color name, e.g. "tomato".

rpc_call.name: RPC call
rpc_call.description: Sends a raw RPC command to the targeted Gen2+ (RPC) Shelly devices and returns each device's response. Works on any Shelly device, not just lights.

method.name: Method
method.description: The RPC method to call, e.g. Switch.Set, Shelly.GetStatus, Sys.GetConfig.

params.name: Parameters
params.description: Optional parameters object for the method, e.g. {"id": 0, "on": true}.
